problems:
  - "crewlet-no-such-cli-binary" is not on this host's PATH — the CLI runs on the ENGINE host, so it must be installed here; set overrides.binary to an absolute path if it lives somewhere unusual
  - providers.llm.sub.overrides.token_env is "MY-TOKEN", which is not an environment variable name (letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit): the CLI is handed its headless token under it, and no secret store, ${VAR} or shell export can hold a name outside that grammar, so neither a stored value nor an export can be read under it, and a token `crewlet llm login -capture-token` minted for it could be neither stored nor referenced. Every write of the company document refuses it: name the variable your build of the CLI reads
  - no sign-in for "sub": no credential files in <state>/claude-code/credentials, and nothing in the environment the CLI is given authenticates it — this machine has a login at <home>/.claude/.credentials.json: adopt it with `crewlet llm login sub -from-host`
